runStatus.description: Set by the cleanup action to stamp the run terminal (instead of deleting the state file), so state — including issues[] — survives for later reads (e.g. /harden) until GC's TTL prunes it.

runCompletedAt.description: Timestamp paired with runStatus, set by the cleanup action.

timedOut.description: Set by `wave-done --timed-out` (R-WAVE-DEADLINE, #506). Read on resume to skip re-waiting.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601. Written by task-done/task-fail (R-WAVE-LIVENESS, #506). Task rows deliberately carry no startedAt.

committedSha.description: The SHA of the commit created for this wave, if committed.

failedTask.description: ID of the most recent non-skipped task-fail. Set by task-fail (R-TASK-17); cleared only by a fresh init.

failedWave.description: Number of the most recent wave-fail. Set by wave-fail (R-TASK-17).

pipelineAuto.description: True when this branch's ship state has flags.auto=true at init time, forwarded so the execute SKILL.md high-risk gate can skip a second approval prompt.

issues.description: Structured issue accumulator appended by task-fail, wave-fail, and DONE_WITH_CONCERNS task-done calls (R-TASK-17). Mirrors deferredFindings in ship-state.schema.json.

guardrailDecisions.description: Append-only list of guardrail decisions recorded by the decide action (KD-2).

pendingIssueDrafts.description: Append-only list of pending GH issue drafts recorded by the issue-draft action.

waveTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-wave timeout in seconds, resolved at init from explicit input > ship-state flags > built-in default (1800). Consumed by wave-await as each open task's total-runtime ceiling (the totalTimeout passed to wave.ClassifyTask).

waveIntervalSeconds.description: Liveness poll interval in seconds, resolved at init from explicit input > ship-state flags > built-in default (60). Consumed by wave-await for three things: (1) the polling cadence between probes; (2) a heartbeat-staleness threshold of 3x this value (default 180s) before a worker is considered stalled; (3) a reclaim grace of max(2x this value, 120s) (default 120s) before an unresponsive worker is failed.

waveAwaitInput.description: Documentation only — not a property of the persisted state document; authoritative source is the jsonschema_description tags on ExecuteStateIn in internal/tools/execute_state.go. Input fields consumed by the wave-await action, which replaces the old client-side stall classification with a single server-driven bounded poll of a wave's still-open task rows.

runId.description: Execution run identifier. Falls back to the value derived from the state's startedAt/wave when omitted.

stateFile.description: Overrides the execution state file path to read/write, instead of the one derived from branch. Also used to persist wave-await's own resume-state (iteration counter) across bounded-poll calls, keyed by runId+wave.

waveAwaitOutput.description: Documentation only — not a property of the persisted state document; authoritative source is the WaveAwaitOut struct (embeds stepper.Envelope) in internal/tools/execute_wave_await.go. Shape returned by one non-blocking wave-await probe.

progress.description: stepper.Envelope field: {iteration, waitedSeconds, timeoutSeconds, intervalSeconds, open[], queued[], stalled[], recorded[]}.

ext.description: stepper.Envelope field. May carry reclaimRequests[] ({taskIds[], workerName, message}, one entry per subject) and failures[] (WaveAwaitFailure: {taskId, workerName, cause: TIMEOUT|STALLED_RECLAIMED|STALLED_NO_REPLY, attempt, retriesLeft, resumeFrom?}).

error.description: stepper.Envelope field. Populated only when status is "error".

next.description: Authoritative instruction the calling skill must follow verbatim: e.g. TaskStop+task-fail, SendMessage reclaim, task-redispatch, dispatch the next task, or poll again. No omitempty — guardrail mcp-output-drives-behavior.

taskRedispatchInput.description: Documentation only — not a property of the persisted state document; authoritative source is the jsonschema_description tags on ExecuteStateIn and the task-redispatch entry in the execute_state tool description, both in internal/tools/execute_state.go. Input fields consumed by task-redispatch, which reopens a failed task for another attempt.

branch.description: Falls back to the current branch when omitted.

runId.description: Falls back to the value derived from the state's startedAt/wave when omitted.

wave.description: Searches every wave for the task's closed row when omitted.

waveStartTaskEntry.description: Documentation only — not a property of the persisted state document; authoritative source is the TasksJSON jsonschema_description tag on ExecuteStateIn in internal/tools/execute_state.go. Three optional fields wave-start accepts per task entry in tasksJson, consumed only to seed server-owned per-task dispatch state (internal/wave.ServerTaskState, a separate unschemed file) — never persisted to this document's waves[].tasks[] rows.

workerName.description: Caller-supplied dispatch identity, never invented; falls back to a generated template when omitted.

batchId.description: Shared by every task in one batch dispatch; omit for a solo task.

batchIndex.description: This task's 0-based position within its batch.
